Amendment to the Third, Sixth and Seventh Schedules under section 3 of Telangana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1963 (Act No.5 of 1963) for Enhancement of life tax in Transport and Non-Transport Vehicles - Notification - Preamble
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
ABSTRACT
Transport Department – Motor Vehicles – Taxation – Amendment to the Third,
Sixth and Seventh Schedules under section 3 of Telangana Motor Vehicles
Taxation Act, 1963 (Act No.5 of 1963) for Enhancement of life tax in Transport
and Non-Transport Vehicles - Notification – Orders - Issued
===========================================
TRANSPORT, ROADS & BUILDINGS(Tr.I) DEPARTMENT
G.O.Ms.No.53 Dated:13.08.2025
Rollhoeewa fidn tg:-
1) G.O.Ms.No.22, TR&B (TR.I) De partment, dated 07.05.2022.
2) From the Transport Commissioner, Telangana State, Hyderabad
Letter No. 2494/S/2024, dated 04.11.2024 and 07.11.2024.
&&&
ORDER:
The following notification shall be published in an extraordinary issue of
the Telangana Gazette, dated:14.08.2025.
NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 of the Telangana Motor
Vehicles Taxation Act, 1963(Act No.5 of 1963), the Government of Telangana
hereby amend the existing Third, Sixth and Seventh Schedules under section 3 the
of Telangana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1963, as amended from time to time
for enhancement of life tax in certain Transport and Non-Transport Vehicles for
improvement of Road Infrastructure, Road Safety and better enforcement.
AMENDMENT
In the said Act:-
